turns.text: OK. And did you get uh, have you got any other symptoms along with that? Any nausea, vomiting, tingling, numbness, weakness, anywhere?

turns.text: OK, and, uh. Sorry [inaudible] . Um, any blurred vision, or any pain over your eyes?

turns.text: Um. No.

turns.text: Any [inaudible] , any funny lights or, anything like that in your vision area? Any problems when you look into the light?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, [inaudible] . No.

turns.text: Um, and have you been eating and drinking OK?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, yes, like normal.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: [inaudible] . Are you feeling sick, or vomiting, or anything?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.text: Not really.

turns.text: I'd say about eight.

turns.text: OK. And have you taken any pain killers?

turns.text: OK, and did that make any difference?

turns.label: Patient

turns.text: That's fine. And any stomach problems, or asthma at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.text: No.

turns.text: Um, and any other drugs?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK. Um, I mean the fact that you haven't had headaches before, um, is, is unusual the fact that they've developed. Is there anything you think's changed? Any increased stress, [inaudible] , change in your diet or lifestyle?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Not that I can, not that I can think of.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. So, what we would suggest is, trying a slightly stronger, pain relief. Uh, so, similar to Ibuprofen, but taking instead of Ibuprofen not at the same time, and taking that regularly with food.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK.

turns.label: Clinician

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Try and um, take rest, have lots of good hydration.Um, but if the pain's getting worse, or you get new symptoms, fever, rash, vomiting, neck stiffness. turns.text: OK. Thank you.

turns.text: Have you got any other questions?

turns.text: Well I should think it should [inaudible] down, if it's getting worse or not settling in the next day or two. Then certainly give us a call back, if, when you've tried the medication that I've prescribed from the pharmacy.
